extracted.intended_audience: people interested in joining or organizing with the Sunrise Movement (climate activists, volunteers, students, local organizers)
extracted.subtask_description: A how-to / call-to-action page that lists ways to participate in the Sunrise Movement: finding or starting local hubs, joining campaigns and phone banks, accessing leader resources, and attending events via Mobilize.

rubrics_metrics.name: Find your local Sunrise
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Locate an existing city, school, or neighborhood hub. If your area isn’t on the map, start one with the New Hubs program.

rubrics_metrics.name: New Hubs program / Start a hub
rubrics_metrics.description: If your city, school, or neighborhood isn’t on the map, start one with our New Hubs program.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provides the pathway and support to launch a local Sunrise hub (implied: follow the New Hubs process to organize locally).

rubrics_metrics.name: Elect Progressive Champions
rubrics_metrics.description: Help elect Congressional candidates who are running to take on Big Oil, Wall Street and our broken political system.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Participate in electoral organizing activities such as phone banking and community organizing to support endorsed candidates.

rubrics_metrics.name: Join a phone bank
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Volunteer to call voters as part of Sunrise electoral and campaign efforts (implied: sign up for scheduled phonebank events).

rubrics_metrics.name: Organize your community
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Engage locally to build support, recruit members, and run actions — e.g., through local hubs and events.

rubrics_metrics.name: Join or start a local hub
rubrics_metrics.description: Join a local hub, or start one.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Find an existing hub to plug into local organizing or follow instructions to found a new hub (links: Find your hub / Start a hub).

rubrics_metrics.name: Welcome Call
rubrics_metrics.description: Welcome Call — Connect with people like you across the country, hear our plan to win, and find your home in the movement.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Sign up to attend an orientation/welcome call to learn about Sunrise, meet others, and learn next steps.

rubrics_metrics.name: Become a Member
rubrics_metrics.description: Become a Member — Join thousands of Sunrise members building power to resist despair, stop the climate crisis, and fight for the Green New Deal future we are owed.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Complete the membership sign-up to be part of the movement and receive organizing opportunities and updates.

rubrics_metrics.name: Movement Leaders Portal
rubrics_metrics.description: The Movement Leaders Portal is designed to be a one-stop-shop for active Sunrise members to find all the resources, support offerings and information they need to fully participate and organize with the movement.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Existing members/leaders use the portal (movement portal login) to access internal resources, calendars, updates, and organizing tools.

rubrics_metrics.name: Students Rise Up Guidebook
rubrics_metrics.guidance: A resource targeted at student organizers (link: Read more).

rubrics_metrics.name: Hilton Action Guide
rubrics_metrics.guidance: A specific action guide (link: Read more) — presumably step-by-step instructions and best practices for that campaign.

rubrics_metrics.name: Sunrise 35+ Supporter Guidelines
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Guidelines for supporters aged 35 and older (link: Read more) — likely describing appropriate conduct/roles for that constituency.

rubrics_metrics.name: Find local and national events / See events on Mobilize
rubrics_metrics.description: FIND LOCAL AND NATIONAL EVENTS — SEE EVENTS ON MOBILIZE
rubrics_metrics.guidance: View and sign up for events using the Mobilize platform (link: GO TO MOBILIZE). Includes 'See all events on Mobilize' and 'See events on Mobilize' calls-to-action.
